question: What should empty input produce, and when should a terminating LF be added?
why_it_matters: This determines exact output for empty files, unterminated text, and whitespace-only input.
recommendation_reason: This keeps empty files empty while giving nonempty inputs a terminating newline without deleting existing trailing blank lines.

options.description: Empty input stays empty; for nonempty input add LF only if normalized output does not already end with LF, preserving existing trailing LFs.
Never add a terminating LF, including for nonempty input.
Always end every output with exactly one LF, including empty input and outputs with trailing blank lines.
